prompt.project_info: A calm meadow portrait built around low golden sun, black hair, and a richly textured maroon knit.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with a feminine silhouette, long center-parted black hair, brown eyes, nude lipstick, and a quiet direct gaze. She wears a deep-maroon full-sleeve ribbed knit wrap top with a flattering V neckline.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical head-and-torso portrait in a dry natural meadow, subject centered with softly blurred grasses behind. No cut-out detail, text, logos, or watermark.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Low sunset side light at 3900K casts a gentle shadow across one side of the face, sunlight highlighting shoulders and chest area, and realistic shadows enhancing curves. Preserve natural skin, knit fibers, and slight film grain.
prompt.technical_specs: 85mm lens at f/2, vertical 3:4 crop, sharp eyes, creamy meadow bokeh, natural vignette, restrained warm grade.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Warm golden-hour meadow portrait of an adult woman with a feminine silhouette, long center-parted black hair, brown eyes, nude lipstick, and a calm direct gaze. She wears a deep-maroon full-sleeve ribbed knit wrap top with a flattering V neckline. Vertical head-and-torso framing, blurred dry grasses, low side sunlight making a soft shadow across the face while highlighting shoulders and chest area, realistic shadows enhancing curves, natural skin texture, knit fibers, 85mm shallow depth of field, warm maroon-and-gold film look, no text or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, deep neckline, cut-out clothing, sexualized pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, readable text, extra fingers
